results.releaseNotes: This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements, along with support for multi-window on iPad. You can now open To Dos List in multiple windows for a more flexible and productive experience. This release also introduces a new widget, making it easier to view and access your to-dos directly from your Home Screen.
results.description:
To Dos List

Stay organized, get things done, and find what you need quickly.

To Dos List is a simple, flexible task manager designed to fit the way you work. Create tasks, add notes, set due dates and priorities, and organize everything with tags.

Siri & Spotlight

With deep integration with Siri and Spotlight, your tasks are easier to discover and interact with throughout your device. Find your tasks, ask Siri about your to-dos, and use natural language to get things done.

Powerful Task Management

- Create tasks with due dates and reminders
- Set priorities for the things that matter most
- Add notes and additional details
- Organize tasks with tags
- Search and filter your tasks using multiple criteria
- Customize how your tasks are sorted and displayed
- Choose from different themes and appearance options

To Dos List is designed to stay out of your way while giving you the flexibility to organize things exactly how you want.

Have feedback or suggestions? I’d love to hear from you and continue making To Dos List better.

results.releaseNotes:
Version 3.0

Notes are in the app. Open, read and edit any note in your vault, right beside the tasks inside it. Every workspace gets a daily note, one tap from search or the calendar agenda.

One field instead of a + button. A floating dock and one omnibar to search, jump anywhere and create. ⌘K on Mac.

Free, optional desktop tools for your agent. Install the taskforge CLI and local MCP server separately on your computer to read and edit tasks and notes. A generated format guide explains your folder's syntax. AI provider account requirements and data handling still apply.

Siri adds tasks for you. Say “Add a task using TaskForge” and it saves without opening the app. On iPhone, TaskForge offers to turn Siri on after your first task.

Lists are now Spaces. Everything carried over, and a space can stack a task section and an event section side by side.

Widgets 3.0. Any section of a space, a bigger XL size, a daily-note tile, and note capture from Control Center.

Edit many tasks at once. Select several and complete, reschedule, edit or delete them across the list, kanban and search.

Free for everyone now: which properties a task row shows, context-menu quick actions, and priority names and colors.

Plus whole-workspace backup and many smaller fixes. Coming from 2.7? A one-time guide walks you through what moved.
results.description:
Bring your tasks, notes and calendar together without creating a TaskForge account. Your tasks and notes stay in local Markdown files you can open in any editor.

Create tasks, write notes and view your calendar for free. Note editing is in beta. Start with a folder of your own or use your existing Obsidian vault, with nothing to import or convert.

A real to-do list and task manager on every screen you use: iPhone, iPad and Mac. Widgets, notifications, a month calendar with your own events beside your tasks, kanban, search, and your notes in the same app.

"After trying many apps and workflows, this is the first one that actually stuck and made me productive!" (user review)

Works with your vault
Reads and writes Obsidian Tasks emoji fields, Dataview fields, Task Genius and TaskNotes YAML frontmatter with your own field mapping. Every edit goes back to the original file.

Home Screen widgets
Today, overdue, a tag, a saved filter or any section of a space, in every size up to XL. Check a task off without opening the app. iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Notifications and reminders
Push notifications for due and scheduled work, several reminders on one task, and a daily summary.

Calendar, built in
Your device calendars (iCloud, Google, Exchange) sit beside your tasks in the month view, in spaces and in widgets. Events come from those calendars, not from files.

Notes and daily notes
Open, read and edit any note in your vault, next to the tasks inside it. Every workspace gets a daily note, one tap from search or the calendar agenda.

Lists, kanban and search
Spaces that stack task and event sections. Custom filtered lists, a kanban board with drag and drop, tags, contexts, projects, priorities, recurring tasks, and start, scheduled and due dates. Search and multi-condition filters across the whole vault. Archive completed tasks instead of deleting them.

Quick capture
Type a task the way you would say it and TaskForge fills in the date, priority and tag.

Optional tools for your AI agent
Use your own AI agent to turn meeting notes into tasks or update your task list. TaskForge generates a guide to your folder's format. The free taskforge desktop CLI and local MCP server, installed separately on your computer, give compatible agents tools to read and edit tasks and notes. These tools run locally without network access. They do not include an AI assistant or subscription. Your chosen AI provider's account requirements and data handling still apply.

Privacy
No TaskForge account, no analytics. Tasks and notes work offline. TaskForge does not upload your task or note files to its own servers. External sync and AI services handle data under their own terms.

TaskForge Premium
The task list, kanban, search and filters, notes and daily notes, quick capture, viewing your calendar, and priority names and colors are free. Premium unlocks Home Screen widgets, notifications and per-task reminders, creating and editing calendar events, your own custom spaces and lists, task defaults, accent color and app font, and editing many tasks at once.
Buy it once and keep it, or subscribe monthly with a 7-day free trial. A monthly subscription renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage it in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian.md or Anthropic.

results.description:
Focus Matrix is a smart personal organizer based on the so-called Eisenhower box, a personal productivity strategy created by Dwight Eisenhower, the 34th President of the United States. The principle uses a special priority matrix that helps break your tasks into several groups depending on their urgency and importance, and work your way through your daily agenda in the most efficient way possible. This app will help you focus on what really matters, and get rid of the things that can be painlessly delegated to others or postponed indefinitely until you have time for them.

Task Organization

•	Two views: Matrix and List of Sections
•	“Unsorted” section to hold incoming tasks until you categorize them
•	Move tasks between sections using drag-and-drop
•	Maximize sections to focus on specific content

Task Scheduling and Reminders

•	Assign due dates to tasks
•	Set “All day task” for whole-day planning
•	Create recurring tasks with customizable repeat options
•	Set reminders to never miss an important deadline

Advanced Task Features

•	Automatically move a task to 'Urgent' as its deadline approaches, with timely notifications
•	Automatically move a task to 'Urgent' when a linked task is completed
•	Track task creation and completion dates for detailed management
•	Paste multiline text as a set of individual tasks to speed up input
•	Edit multiple tasks simultaneously to save your time

Sorting, Filtering, and Tags

•	Sort tasks by title, due date, or manually
•	Use tags to organize tasks effectively
•	Filter tasks by tags and statuses (completed/uncompleted)
•	Save and quickly apply custom filter presets for easy navigation

Synchronization and Integration

•	Sync data across all your devices
•	Sync tasks with Calendar
•	Integrate with Be Focused*: Sync tasks between apps and start timer in Be Focused directly from Focus Matrix

Exporting and Reporting

•	Configurable statistics and reports for completed tasks
•	Export task lists to PDF or print them for offline use
•	Share task lists via email, messages, or directly to Facebook, Twitter, etc.

Security and Privacy

•	Password and Face ID protection for secure task management

Platform Compatibility

•	Fully available for iOS and Mac

Pro Version Features

•	Cross-device synchronization
•	Synchronization of tasks with Calendar
•	Integration with Be Focused*: Sync tasks between apps and start timer in Be Focused directly from Focus Matrix

Focus Matrix is free to download and use forever. However, if you want to access the Pro features on all your iPhones, iPads, and Macs, you can upgrade to the Pro version. The Pro subscription comes in three different options: Monthly, Yearly with a 7-day trial, and Lifetime (one-time payment).

Payment will be charged to your App Store account and will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://xwavesoft.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://xwavesoft.com/terms-of-use.html

* Be Focused helps you get things done by breaking up individual tasks among discrete intervals. It’s available for Mac and iOS devices in the App Store. Integration with Be Focused requires the Pro version of Be Focused, sold separately.

results.releaseNotes:
Team tasks update while you are looking at them

Before this update, a task your colleague assigned you would not show up until you left Okko and came back. The timeline now quietly pulls your team's latest while you are still in the app.

We also added pull to refresh on the main screen, for the moments you want to be sure you are seeing everything.

And any task you already have can now be handed to your team. Assigning used to be possible only while creating the task.
results.description:
Okko is a personal task manager built around one idea: adding a task should be as fast as saying it.

Say "call the client tomorrow at 5 pm" and you're done. Okko extracts the title, the time and the tag on its own, and only asks when something is missing. Arabic or English.

With your team
- Create a team and invite people with a QR code or a link — no accounts, no passwords.
- Assign tasks to members from the task screen and see who finished and who is blocked.
- A leader can let a member assign on their behalf.

Add by voice from anywhere
- Siri: "Hey Siri, add a task in Okko".
- Amazon Alexa: link your account with a pairing code, then say "Alexa, ask Okko to add ...".

A buzz, not a noise
- A silent vibration at the task's time, no sound.
- Repeats every 2, 5 or 10 minutes (your choice) for as long as you set, until you tap Done or Stop.
- Done / Snooze / Stop right from the notification.

Your day as a timeline
- Today's tasks ordered by hour with a live "Now" line.
- A 30-day horizon: recurring tasks show their upcoming occurrences, overdue ones get their own section.
- Simple tags: Work, Home, Friends, Life, Health - and your own.

Recurring without the hassle
- Daily, weekly, monthly, workdays or custom days. Completing a task creates the next one automatically.

Calendar events become tasks
- Import iPhone calendar events (iCloud, Google, Outlook) as tasks with the buzz; they update when the event changes.
- Optional Microsoft 365 connection to read your work calendar directly.

Add from anywhere
- Siri: "Add a task to Okko".
- Action Button: one press to speak.
- Widgets on the Home and Lock Screen.
- Share any text from WhatsApp, Messages or Mail to Okko and it becomes a task instantly.

Privacy first
- Your data stays on your device; iCloud sync is optional and lives in your own account.
- Optional passcode lock with Face ID.
- No account, no tracking, no ads.

Available in Arabic and English, following your device language.

results.description:
Google Tasks Client is the best application for using Google Tasks on your desktop.
It supports synchronization with Google Tasks, task refinement, reordering, full-text search, shortcuts, multiple Google accounts, menu bar, notifications, app badges, M1 tips, and English.

■ How to start
  1. launch the app
  2. sign in with your Google account
  3. That's it!
Your Google Tasks will be loaded immediately and displayed in full screen.
You can swap tasks by dragging and dropping, add subtasks to tasks, and use the simple UI.

■ Features
・Google Tasks sync
    - Mobile app sync
    - Google Calendar sync

・Task refinement
    - Today
    - Tomorrow
    - Day after tomorrow
    - Expired
    - All

・Sorting Tasks
    - Drag & Drop
    - Sort by due date
    - Alphabetically

・Search Tasks
    - Full-text search of all tasks

・Shortcut
    - Add global shortcut to tasks (Command + Shift + A)
    - Keyboard shortcuts

・Multiple Google Accounts
    - Unlimited number of additional accounts
    - One-click switching

・Design
    - Google's Material Design
    - UI like Microsoft To Do or Wunderlist
    - Dark mode support

・High performance
    - M1 chip support

・Menu bar
    - Task management from icons

・Notifications
    - Alert notification on due date

・App badge
    - Displays the number of uncompleted tasks

■ Security
・Your data will not be sent to any server other than Google.
・Data will be exchanged directly with Google. Not even the developer can see the contents.
・Only OAuth authentication (Google OAuth 2.0) is used for login authentication.
・It does not ask you to enter your password or save it at all.

■ Support for English
・You can change the language to "English".
・Calendar and dates follow the English format.

■ Support
If you have any problems, we will be happy to support you in English.
Please contact us at the following e-mail address and we will reply within 48 hours.
info@thetodo.net

■ Why Google Tasks Client?
The browser version of Google Tasks is a great application.
However, because it is provided as a sidebar to Gmail and other applications, the screen is too small and not always easy to use.
Google Tasks Client is an application that pursues the idea that Google Tasks should be more like this.

We want everyone who uses this application to be happy with it, and we are second to none.
That is the promise from Google Tasks Client.
